defects.description: frontend.depends_on names service `api`, but no such service is defined (the application service is named `backend`).
paraphrases: The frontend depends on `api`, which is not a defined service (frontend, backend, mongo).
defects.rationale: Findable by cross-checking frontend.depends_on against the service list; the app service is `backend`.

defects.description: backend.depends_on names service `db`, but the database service is named `mongo`; there is no service `db`.
paraphrases: The backend depends on `db`, but the database service is `mongo`.
defects.rationale: Findable by cross-checking backend.depends_on against the service list; the DB service is `mongo`.

defects.description: backend.networks references `mongo-net`, which is not declared under the top-level `networks` key (only `react-express` and `express-mongo` exist).
paraphrases: backend joins network `mongo-net`, but only `react-express` and `express-mongo` are defined.
Dangling network reference in the backend service.
defects.rationale: Findable by cross-checking backend.networks against the top-level networks; mongo-net is undefined (should be express-mongo).
